_meta.title: Gospels — one verse per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: One curated verse from each of the 89 chapters of the four Gospels (Matthew 28, Mark 16, Luke 24, John 21), keyed by book + chapter. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content; not tied to any one app's taxonomy. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, books 40-43), cross-checked against the local KJV; verses verbatim
_meta.keying: book + chapter; one verse per chapter; 89 total across Matthew, Mark, Luke, John
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton), so no divine-name adaptation was needed; text is verbatim KJV (curly apostrophes normalized to straight). No review gate — author is reviewer.

gospels.text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
gospels.plain: A child is coming who will be called Emmanuel — a name that means 'God with us.'

gospels.text: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
gospels.plain: Where is the newborn King? We saw his star rise, and we've come to worship him.

gospels.text: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
gospels.plain: Then a voice came from heaven: 'This is my Son, the one I love; I'm so pleased with him.'

gospels.text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
gospels.plain: People don't live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

gospels.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
gospels.plain: Let your light shine out where people can see it, so they notice the good you do and give glory to your Father in heaven.

gospels.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
gospels.plain: Seek God's kingdom and his kind of living first, and everything else you need will be given to you as well.

gospels.text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
gospels.plain: Ask, and it will be given to you; look, and you'll find; knock, and the door will be opened.

gospels.text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
gospels.plain: Why are you so afraid? Where's your faith? Then he stood up, told the wind and waves to stop, and everything went perfectly calm.

gospels.text: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
gospels.plain: I want mercy, not just religious ritual. I didn't come for people who think they're fine, but for those who know they need help.

gospels.text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
gospels.plain: So don't be afraid — you're worth far more than a whole flock of sparrows.

gospels.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
gospels.plain: Come to me, all of you who are worn out and weighed down, and I will give you rest.

gospels.text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
gospels.plain: Anyone who does what my Father in heaven wants is my brother and sister and mother.

gospels.text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
gospels.plain: The seed on good ground is the person who hears the message and really gets it — and their life bears fruit, far more than was planted.

gospels.text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
gospels.plain: Right away Jesus spoke to them: 'Take heart — it's me. Don't be afraid.'

gospels.text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
gospels.plain: It's not what goes into your mouth that makes you unclean; it's what comes out of it.

gospels.text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
gospels.plain: If anyone wants to follow me, they need to let go of themselves, take up their cross, and come after me.

gospels.text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
gospels.plain: If you had faith even the size of a mustard seed, you could tell a mountain to move, and it would — nothing would be impossible for you.

gospels.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
gospels.plain: Wherever two or three of you come together in my name, I'm right there among you.

gospels.text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
gospels.plain: On their own, people can't do it — but with God, everything is possible.

gospels.text: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
gospels.plain: Even the Son of Man didn't come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life to set many free.

gospels.text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
gospels.plain: Whatever you ask for in prayer, if you truly believe, you'll receive it.

gospels.text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
gospels.plain: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.

gospels.text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
gospels.plain: Anyone who lifts himself up will be brought low, and anyone who humbles himself will be lifted up.

gospels.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
gospels.plain: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words never will.

gospels.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
gospels.plain: Well done, good and faithful servant. You were faithful with a little, so I'll put you in charge of much. Come and share your master's joy.

gospels.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
gospels.plain: Stay alert and pray, so you don't fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak.

gospels.text: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
gospels.plain: When the soldiers guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that happened, they were terrified and said, 'This really was the Son of God.'

gospels.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
gospels.plain: Teach them to do everything I've commanded you. And remember — I am with you always, right to the end of the age.

gospels.text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
gospels.plain: Come, follow me, and I'll make you fishers of people.

gospels.text: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
gospels.plain: Healthy people don't need a doctor — sick people do. I didn't come for those who think they're fine, but for those who know they've failed.

gospels.text: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
gospels.plain: Anyone who does what God wants is my brother, my sister, and my mother.

gospels.text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
gospels.plain: He stood up and said to the storm, 'Peace. Be still.' The wind died down, and everything went completely calm.

gospels.text: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
gospels.plain: Don't be afraid. Just believe.

gospels.text: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
gospels.plain: Come away with me to a quiet place, and rest for a while.

gospels.text: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
gospels.plain: They were completely amazed and said, 'He has done everything well — he even makes the deaf hear and the silent speak.'

gospels.text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
gospels.plain: What good is it to gain the whole world if you lose your own soul?

gospels.text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
gospels.plain: If you can believe — everything is possible for the person who believes.

gospels.text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
gospels.plain: Even the Son of Man didn't come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life to set many free.

gospels.text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
gospels.plain: Whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you've received it, and it will be yours.

gospels.text: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
gospels.plain: Love your neighbor as yourself. No commandment is greater than these.

gospels.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
gospels.plain: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words never will.

gospels.text: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
gospels.plain: He prayed, 'Abba, Father, everything is possible for you — take this cup from me. Yet not what I want, but what you want.'

gospels.text: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
gospels.plain: When the officer standing there saw how Jesus died, he said, 'This man really was the Son of God.'

gospels.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
gospels.plain: Go out into the whole world and share the good news with everyone.

gospels.text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
gospels.plain: Nothing is impossible with God.

gospels.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
gospels.plain: Today, in the town of David, a Savior has been born for you — he is Christ the Lord.

gospels.text: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
gospels.plain: If you have two coats, give one to someone who has none; and if you have food, do the same.

gospels.text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
gospels.plain: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has chosen me to bring good news to the poor, to heal broken hearts, to free the captives, to give sight to the blind, and to release the oppressed.

gospels.text: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
gospels.plain: So they brought their boats to shore, left everything behind, and followed him.

gospels.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
gospels.plain: Give, and it will be given back to you — a full measure, pressed down, shaken together, and overflowing, poured into your lap. The way you give is the way you'll receive.

gospels.text: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
gospels.plain: He told the woman, 'Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.'

gospels.text: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
gospels.plain: He said to her, 'Daughter, take heart — your faith has made you well. Go in peace.'

gospels.text: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
gospels.plain: No one who starts plowing and keeps looking back is fit for the kingdom of God.

gospels.text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
gospels.plain: Don't celebrate that the spirits obey you — celebrate that your names are written in heaven.

gospels.text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
gospels.plain: Even more blessed are those who hear God's word and live it out.

gospels.text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
gospels.plain: Don't be afraid, little flock — your Father is delighted to give you the kingdom.

gospels.text: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
gospels.plain: People will come from east and west, north and south, and take their place at the table in God's kingdom.

gospels.text: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
gospels.plain: Anyone who lifts himself up will be brought low, and anyone who humbles himself will be lifted up.

gospels.text: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
gospels.plain: So he got up and went to his father. While he was still far off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion — he ran to his son, threw his arms around him, and kissed him.

gospels.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
gospels.plain: Whoever is faithful with a little will be faithful with a lot; whoever is dishonest with a little will be dishonest with a lot too.

gospels.text: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
gospels.plain: You won't be able to point and say, 'Here it is!' or 'There it is!' — because the kingdom of God is within you.

gospels.text: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
gospels.plain: He told them a story to show that they should always pray and never give up.

gospels.text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
gospels.plain: The Son of Man came to look for and to rescue the ones who were lost.

gospels.text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
gospels.plain: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living — to him, everyone is alive.

gospels.text: In your patience possess ye your souls.
gospels.plain: By staying steady and patient, you will keep hold of your soul.

gospels.text: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
gospels.plain: He took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to them, saying, 'This is my body, given for you. Do this to remember me.'

gospels.text: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
gospels.plain: Jesus told him, 'I promise you, today you will be with me in paradise.'

gospels.text: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
gospels.plain: He is not here — he has risen! Remember what he told you while he was still in Galilee.

gospels.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
gospels.plain: To everyone who received him and believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

gospels.text: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
gospels.plain: His mother told the servants, 'Whatever he tells you, do it.'

gospels.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
gospels.plain: God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him won't perish but will have eternal life.

gospels.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
gospels.plain: Whoever drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again — it becomes a spring inside them, welling up to eternal life.

gospels.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
gospels.plain: Anyone who hears my word and believes the One who sent me has eternal life. They won't be condemned — they've already crossed over from death into life.

gospels.text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
gospels.plain: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

gospels.text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
gospels.plain: If anyone is thirsty, let them come to me and drink.

gospels.text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
gospels.plain: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

gospels.text: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
gospels.plain: Whether he's a sinner or not, I don't know. One thing I do know: I was blind, and now I can see.

gospels.text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
gospels.plain: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came so they could have life, and have it to the full.

gospels.text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
gospels.plain: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live, even if they die.

gospels.text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
gospels.plain: I have come as light into the world, so that no one who believes in me has to stay in the dark.

gospels.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
gospels.plain: I'm giving you a new command: love one another. Just as I have loved you, you are to love one another.

gospels.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
gospels.plain: I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

gospels.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
gospels.plain: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever stays connected to me bears much fruit — because apart from me you can't do anything.

gospels.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
gospels.plain: I've told you this so that in me you can have peace. In this world you'll have trouble — but take heart: I have overcome the world.

gospels.text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
gospels.plain: This is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you sent.

gospels.text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
gospels.plain: 'So you are a king?' Jesus answered, 'You say I'm a king. For this I was born, and for this I came into the world — to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.'

gospels.text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
gospels.plain: When Jesus had received the drink, he said, 'It is finished.' Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

gospels.text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
gospels.plain: Because you've seen me, you believe, Thomas. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.

gospels.text: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
gospels.plain: If I want him to stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.
